content.text: According to Guinness World Records, **The Oregon Trail** is the longest-running video game franchise (1971–present). It was originally developed by MECC (Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium) and its creators Don Rawitsch, Bill Heinemann, and Paul Dillenberger.
